content: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: We frequently paralyze ourselves with regret over past procrastination, lamenting the years we failed to learn a language, save money, or cultivate a craft. But regret cannot travel backward in time. The present hour is the only fertile soil you will ever own.
practicalInsight: Stop mourning the lost years. Take the first concrete step toward that neglected dream before your head hits the pillow tonight.
reflectionPrompt: What worthwhile pursuit have you been putting off with the excuse 'it's too late now'?
